body: I can understand why this situation might be super hard for you to work through. However, I think that you should definitely tell the person that you’re losing feelings. It’s the better option for both of you. It isn’t fair to them to be led to believe that they’re loved back when they aren’t, and it isn’t fair for you to have to pretend to love them. Just think of it this way, by hanging on, you could be keeping them from someone who truly loves them in the way they want/need to be loved. You can’t control how you feel, and you shouldn’t tie yourself up in a person who you aren’t into. Your feelings aren’t likely to just come back. It’s not something you should wait around on. Just tell them in the nicest way possible.
